reasoning_content: Let me check the server log to see if the browser made any requests after deploying mobile version.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Check latest nginx access
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/nginx/access.log")
print("Recent access:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
